title: Fix Window Celebrate Conic Gradient
description: When windows are celebrating they are not showing the proper conic gradient as e.g. a button and instead they wrongly just switch the three colors. Fix the window silhouette celebrate ring so it matches the spinning three-color conic gradient used by [data-celebrated=true]::after on buttons and other elements, instead of the stroke color-cycle keyframes.
summary: Fixed celebrating docked windows so their silhouette matches the button celebrate ring: a spinning three-color conic gradient with pulsing thickness, instead of cycling solid stroke colors. ModeDockStackSilhouetteBorder now paints celebrated via a masked foreignObject fill (same conic + celebrate-border-spin as [data-celebrated=true]::after); CSS dropped the solid color-cycle keyframes. Added a regression test asserting the conic fill/mask structure.
